content: Jesu yo Tuma Aiyetwa ano Kukwana Likumi na Yiili (12)
Cwale sebeli oisana aiyetwa no kukwana likumi ni twiili bamweya mi sebeli waaba amaata ni tukelo beulu no mandimona onje mane ni ku balisa ameeti.
Cwale Jesu sebeli waatuma nji akaiyete eino mubuso wa Nyambe mane nuka balisa awo akola ameeti,
mi sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Mulese okushimba esinu sinjili ba mwendo, simba olusata, simba esipaupau, simba esinkwa, simba amali, mane mulese okushimba etihembe timbili.
Endoo yonje mwingena mi kame amitambula, mwikalemo okubitela abo samutunde mu mulenen̄i omo,
mi oko konje samwingene nji kamitambula, aba mutunda mu tolopo omo, mutotomone amaluli na kumakondo enu nji atende oupaki kwa onyene.”
Aiyetwa sebeli ata mu mindi yonje aka iyete eliywi ni kubalisa asikutoma ameeti mu ibaka yonje.
Okulyangana kwa Heloda
Cwale Heloda, omubusisi abana kuyupa eyo ina kutendahala yonje, sebeli okomoka onene kakuli anjili kame ana kwambanga nji Jowani omukolobezi nainguka kwaafu.
Anjili kame ana kwambanga nji Eliya wamonahala kale, mi anjili kame ana kwambanga nji omunjili no anuhi a Nyambe nakukale nainguka.
Heloda sebeli wamba nji, “Jowani woyo nina kupatula omutwi, kono anyine woyo niyupa eyaye?” Mi sebeli osaela okumona Jesu.
Jesu yo Fepa Aanu no kukwana Eikitti Mutanu
Atumiwa aba ana kuuka sebeli ambela Jesu einu yonje ana tende. Cwale sebeli washimba ni kuta noo ku mulenen̄i oisaniwa Betisaida.
Cwale aanu no kupula aba ana kuyupa ngeeso, sebeli amukon̄a mi sebeli waatambula wino ni kwamba kwa onyene eyo no mubuso wa Nyambe mane sebeli obalisa awo ana kusinga okublisiwa.

Abo eliywaa elita mu kwiika, atumiwa no kukwana elikumi na yiili sebeli aiya kwa Jesu ni kwamba nji, “Ouse aanu nji akutele mu mindi ni mwilalanda monje ili beebi nji aka kusaelele oko sakalangane neso no kulya kakuli muno tuli ni mu sibaka sikushweekile.”
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Anyi luli mwaabe eyi no kulya.” Cwale sebeli atambula nji, “Kame tuli feela ni inkwa itanu ni tindi timbili, konji aba satute nji tukaa ulele eino kulya onje.

Oko kame kuna kwikalanga alume no kukwana eikiti itanu (5;000) Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa iyetwa aye nji, “Mwambele aanu aikale banji mu ikwata akwanine eititi makumi atanu mu sikwata ni sikwata (50).”
Cwale sebeli atenda ngeeso mane ni kwikala mu ikwata ni kwikala onje banji,
cwale Jesu sebeli olonda einkwa itanu ni tindi timbili, sebeli waliketa kuwilu ni kuba etumbo mane ni kwipatola ni kwiiba kwa iyetwa aye nji atabele aanu.
Cwale onje sebeli alya ni kwikuta, mane sebeli atolabo amatanda no kukwana likumi ni twiili no ubulumusi onaku siyalako.
Pitolosi yo Amba eyi ya Jesu
Cwale Jesu yoli yomboci yolapela aiyetwa sebeli aiya kwa yonyene mi sebeli waibanguta nji, “Kandi aanu kame aamba nji time anyine?”
Mi sebeli atambula nji, “Kame aamba nji tiwe Jowani omukolobezi, aanjili nji tiwe Eliya, mi anjili kame aamba nji omunjili no anuhi naku kale nainguka.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli waibanguta nji, “Cwale anyi kame mwamba nji time anyine?” Mi Pitolosi sebeli otambula nji, “Tiwe Kilesite wa Nyambe.”
Jesu yo Amba eyi no Mayando ni lifu Lyaye
Kono cwale Jesu sebeli waaba emamela nji alese okwambela omunu yonje
nji, “Omwana no munu kame afanena okuyanda einu no kupula, mi akaniwe kwa kulu ni kwa kulu no apulisita mane na sikun̄ola, mi aibaiwe mane nji ba liywa no waatu aingulwe kwaafu.”
Cwale sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Omunu yonje woyo osaela oku nikon̄a akutobohe yonyene mi akutweke esifapano saye mu maywaa onje cwale anikon̄e.
Abo kwa woyo osaela okuyoyisa omooyo waye mbau taukelwe, mi woyo otaukelwa omooyo waye mulibaka lyange mba yoyisiwa.
Siikene sawane omunu aba amuna elitunga lyonje, ni kutaukelwa omooyo waye simba okukomiwa?
Woyo yonje soni enene mane ni maywi ange, ni yonyene Omwana no munu mba mwenene aba saiye mu kanya yaye ni mu kanya ya sitaye neyi no mangeloi no kukena.
Kono kame ni myambela eniti luli nji kwaali anjili aimanine bano awo katamba okufa akasi mona kale omubuso wa Nyambe.”
Okufutuka kwa Jesu
Munyima no maywaa atanu naatu Jesu aba ana kumana okwamba eyi sebeli oshimba Pitolosi, Jowani ni Jakobo ni kuta noo ba lilundu okalapela.
Jesu yo lapela, sebeli omonahala olutu ni ikumango yaye okufutuka mane sebeli itenda eyi no likena too onene.
Ababo sebeli kumonahala alume ayiili aambola ni Jesu. Awo neli Mushe ni Eliya
awo ana kumonahala mu kanya aamba eyi no kuta kwaye eyo ana kufanena oka manenena ku Jelusalema.
Cwale Pitolosi nawo ana kwikala noo kame nalangananga onene ba tolo, cwale aba ana kwinguka sebeli amona ekanya ya Jesu na lume ayiili awo ana kwimananga naye.

Cwale alume aba ana kusiya Jesu, Pitolosi sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Molyange, nikwakuwaba ngasibine nji twikale feela bano! Tuyake eikun̄wa yaatu, esinjili sitende sowe, esinjili sa Mushe mane esinjili sitende sa Eliya.” Mukwalimuka eso ana kwamba.
Abo yo amba eyo, sebeli kwiiya elikumbi ni kwafuka, mi sebeli acila aba ana kufukiwa ku likumbi.
Cwale eliywi sebeli litunda mu likumbi eli lyamba nji, “Wuyu ya Mwanange woyo ni nakete, mumuyupe!”
Cwale eliywi aba lina kumana okwamba, Jesu sebeli okumona nji kame ali yomboci. Aiyetwa sebeli aondoka feela nambulwa okwambela omunu kweyi ana mono.
Jesu yo Balisa Ondumbana no Mebo no Kwiiba
Eliywaa linaku tatamako Jesu na iyetwa aatu aba ana kushetumuka okutunda ba lilundu, cwale aanu no kupula sebeli akuwana ni Jesu.
Cwale komumone, omulume sebeli okuwa okutunda mwaanu no kupula nji, “Mwiyeti! Kame ni kukumbela nji oni monene mwanange, kakuli yomwanange nili naye nisepile yomboci!
Cwale komumone emebo no kwiiba kame imulemanga muwanguwangu ni kulila onene ni kumoowa okutwala abo sakatundele olufulo ku kanwa mane ni kumukwiseta banji yonyakola eyisi mulemine.
Cwale kame nina kumbele aiyetwa owe nji aitundise kono nakwangwa.”
Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Anyi aanu nakwapumena ni lusika nakwayupa! Ba nako no kukuma babine saniikale naanyi? Ba nako no kukuma babine sani miiyete? Kolite mwanowe kuno.”
Ababo ondumbana yokeyile, emebo no kwiba sebeli ingena mwayonyene okumulyanganisa. Kono Jesu sebeli olaela emebo no kwiiba, sebeli obalisa ondumbana ni kumuba kwa sitaye.

Mi onje kame ana kukomoka amaata no kuneneba a Nyambe. Jesu yo Amba kame eyi no Lifu Lyaye (Mateu17.22-23; Maleka9.30-32) Kono abo aanu asikomokile kweyo yonje anatende, sebeli wamba kwa iyetwa aye nji,
“Muteetete wino ku maywi awo sanambe bano, Omwana no munu mbabeekiwa mu maoko no aanu.
Kono kasi kuyupisisa omwambelo ou, kakuli kame ona kushwekiwa kwa onyene, nji alese okuyupisisa wino mi kame ana kucilanga okumwibanguta etaluso no mwambelo owo.
Anyine No Kuneneba Onene?
Cwale etin̄ananyi sebeli tiinguka mukaci koo nji anyine no kuneneba mukaci koo.
Kono Jesu aba ana kumona emihupulo eli mu micima yoo, sebeli oshimba omwanuke ni kumwimeka kunyonga yaye,

cwale sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Woyo yonje sotambula wuyu mwanuke mu litina lyange natambula mene, mi woyo yonje sotambula mene natambula woyo ona nitumu. Mi cwale woyo no mamaneneno mukaci kenu yo munene kwaanyi.”
Omunu yonje nji Kakulwisi kame Ali ni Wene
Jowani sebeli otambula nji, “Molyange, natumono omulume woyo otundisa amandimona mu litina lyowe natu mukanisa, kakuli kasa wetu.
Kono cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Mulese okumu kanisa kakuli nji omunu kakulwisi woyo kame ali kwa wene.”
Cwale amaywaa aba ana kusheeteta abeebi nji atambuliwe ku wilu, sebeli okutukiseta okuta ku Jelusalema.
Cwale sebeli otuma atumiwa balubala mu mundi wisaniwa nji Samalitani nji aka mulukisete einu.
Kono aanu kasiku mutambula kakuli olubala lwaye kame luna kulukisetwa okuta ku Jelusalema.
Mi cwale aiyetwa aye Jakobo ni Jowani aba ana kumona ngeeso, sebeli aamba nji, “Mbumu, kame usinga nji aci tukumbele omulilo okutunda ku wilu nji wiiye mukwa cin̄a?
Kono Jesu sebeli ofutuka ni kwakalimela.
Cwale sebeli aekeza okuta mu mundi munjili.
Awo Afanena Okutenda Akon̄eleli a Jesu
Cwale akatile ngeseo mu mweendo woo, omulume munjili sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Kame sani kukon̄e oko konje soote.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Aluwawa kame akwite emina, mi otuyunyi oto tutuka mu mebo kame tukwite eiyaleto, kono Omwana no munu kakwite naba no kusama omutwi waye.”
Ku munjili sebeli wamba nji, “Onikon̄e.” Kono sebeli wamba nji, “Mbumu oweli nite nika pumbeke sitange.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Mulesele aafu apumbeke aafu oo, cwale kono wene ote oka iyete eyi no mubuso wa Nyambe.”
Kame omunjili kwa onyene sebeli wambela Jesu nji, “Mbi kukon̄o, kono oweli nite nikalaane asi ndoo yange.”
Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Kakwisa omunu olemine ku sikekele ni kwaliketa kunyima woyo kafanene mu mubuso wa Nyambe.”
